rationale: The input is synchronized into the single edge-detector clock domain and all three synchronous status outputs have delays relative to the declared clock.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the edge detector to a one-bit two-flop input synchronizer and registered history for rising and falling pulses.

mutation.description: Both edge indications are combinational decodes of registered state, so they share the edge-detector clock contract.
